payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics used for evaluating the quality and diversity of generated text, including BLEU, perplexity, self-BLEU, and the percentage of unique n-grams.

claims.text: The evaluation metrics include BLEU, perplexity, self-BLEU, and the percentage of unique n-grams.
BLEU measures the similarity between generated sentences and original data distributions.
Perplexity serves as a proxy for fluency in evaluating generated text.
Self-BLEU measures the diversity of generated sentences by comparing them to each other.
The percentage of unique n-grams indicates the diversity of the generated text.
